command:
set -eu
test ! -e /opt/odin-packaging-a839999
curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.0.2.2:47652/odin-a839999.bundle -o /opt/odin-transfer/odin-a839999.bundle
printf '%s\n' '4cddaad4bf14fea3f78fc9c9fb8c3f1cd341b5e8ac49794515350daf51da844a  /opt/odin-transfer/odin-a839999.bundle' | sha256sum --check -
curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.0.2.2:47652/odin-a839999-source-sha256.json -o /opt/odin-transfer/odin-a839999-source-sha256.json
printf '%s\n' '3163f43fb6ab600bf2dde2da423a4042a795a83d378fe3d29b498f8e156601a1  /opt/odin-transfer/odin-a839999-source-sha256.json' | sha256sum --check -
runuser -u odin-qa -- git -C /opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba bundle verify /opt/odin-transfer/odin-a839999.bundle
install -d -o odin-qa -g odin-qa /opt/odin-packaging-a839999
runuser -u odin-qa -- git clone --quiet /opt/odin-transfer/odin-a839999.bundle /opt/odin-packaging-a839999
runuser -u odin-qa -- python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
app_root=pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba');pack_root=pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-packaging-a839999')
app=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba-source-sha256.json').read_text())
pack=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-transfer/odin-a839999-source-sha256.json').read_text())
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=pack_root,text=True).strip()==pack['revision']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=pack_root)
for row in pack['files']:
    content=(pack_root/row['path']).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()==row['sha256'] and len(content)==row['bytes'],row['path']
def product(path):return path.startswith(('crates/','schemas/','dashboard/','scripts/','packaging/','tests/')) or path in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','rust-toolchain.toml')
before={row['path']:row['sha256'] for row in app['files'] if product(row['path'])}
after={row['path']:row['sha256'] for row in pack['files'] if product(row['path'])}
assert before==after
for path,digest in before.items():assert hashlib.sha256((app_root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==hashlib.sha256((pack_root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
report={'status':'PASS','app_build_revision':app['revision'],'packaging_revision':pack['revision'],'bundled_docs_revision':pack['revision'],'packaging_files_checked':len(pack['files']),'product_equivalence':{'status':'PASS','compared_files':len(before)},'packaging_source_clean':True,'binary_rebuilt':False}
pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-delivery/v3-0fe03ba/packaging-source-stage.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report))
PY
